% A test for tex8web: LaTeX's own \newtheorem with hyperref, but without
% amsmath, whose \ifmeasuring@ hyperref's \MakeLinkTarget tests. The
% theorem's link leads where a \ref to it does.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{theorem}\label{thm:one}A numbered theorem.\end{theorem}
Theorem~\ref{thm:one} is numbered.
\end{document}
